purpose: not a new calibration method. It hardens the CAM-EXP-001..004 results that CAM-EXP-005 will build on, and fixes in writing what is confirmed and what is still exploratory.
prior_runs: CAM-EXP-001 .. CAM-EXP-004 are read-only; no file of theirs was modified

statistics.problem: CAM-EXP-003.1 bootstrapped over 1400 frames, but 8 frames of one static camera are not 8 independent observations of that camera's calibration error

resampling_units.PHYSICAL_CAMERA_CLUSTER: 40 unique physical camera ids - same lens across takes
resampling_units.SEQUENCE_CLUSTER: 5 sequences - SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ONLY, too few clusters for a trustworthy CI

statistics.point_estimates: unchanged - only the uncertainty around them is recomputed

e2_freeze.rule: the E2 formula, its members and its aggregation are frozen; CAM-EXP-005/006 may not modify them

loso.protocol: leave one sequence out; pick the best of E1-E5 on the 4 training sequences, evaluate that pick on the held-out one
loso.status: RETROSPECTIVE_INTERNAL_VALIDATION - never called an independent test

frame_count_extension.grid: np.linspace(0, n_valid_frames-1, 64).astype(int) - the CAM-EXP-003 8-frame grid refined 8x; because 63 = 9*7 the original 8 frames are an EXACT subset
frame_count_extension.nested_sets: 8 < 16 < 32 < 64 by deterministic farthest-point insertion seeded with the frozen 8
frame_count_extension.selection_inputs: video length only. NOT GT focal, NOT model predictions, NOT hand annotation, NOT scene content
frame_count_extension.processing_order: results/summary/extension_view_order.csv - per-sequence random permutation (seed 20260923) interleaved round-robin, so any prefix is stratified; frozen before any result was seen
frame_count_extension.aggregation: frozen from CAM-EXP-004: AnyCalib median, GeoCalib median, E2 per the frozen spec. NO new aggregator was invented.
frame_count_extension.pf_excluded: PerspectiveFields was not re-run: it was clearly weakest in CAM-EXP-004 and no claim here depends on it

anycam.intent: SUPPLEMENTARY_STATIC_STRESS_TEST, never a benchmark and never an equal baseline
anycam.checkpoint: fwimbauer/anycam_v1_seq8 pytorch_model.bin (official HuggingFace location used by the repo's own hubconf.py)
anycam.interpretation_rule: if no focal information is recoverable, say the official formulation is not identifiable in our static-camera condition - never 'AnyCam is bad'

provenance.requirement: exact commit SHA, not 'main'; checkpoint SHA256; inference command; output convention

holdout.rule: no holdout result may influence method choice, ensemble membership, weights, thresholds or cue rules; structural sanity checks allowed and logged
